title: Temperature range band with boundary lines
intent: Show a time-varying low-to-high temperature interval with an area using explicit y1 and y2 channels and two independently styled boundary lines, mirroring Plot's sf-temperature-band-area fixture.

source.title: Observable Plot area mark — range bands

ai.create: Create a responsive UTC temperature band from {id, date, low, high} rows. Fill the interval from low to high with one area and draw distinct low and high boundary lines from the same rows, with fully inferred channels and no data duplication.
ai.maintain: Add a 32-degree freezing reference rule and make the band react to light and dark themes while preserving the explicit low/high interval, boundary line geometry, and cast-free field inference.
